result.note: Actual own parser/expander/checker and unchanged opaque drivers; no image patch, AST replay or replacement checker. Diagnostics are not clean CPU/peak-RAM evidence. Uncollected samples may include garbage not yet collected; they are not strong-retention proof. A heap snapshot can induce GC and pause execution, and is a separate diagnostic prefix.

numericCensus.scope: Numeric value/owner references in snapshot. Smi/artificial nodes are NOT allocated objects; HeapNumber node identity/type is not itself proof of allocator traffic, in-object layout or causal boxing. Hidden/property views may overlap; do not add rows or call them exclusive retained bytes. Snapshot induces GC and is not peak-memory evidence.

facts: Actual descriptor fields include high-bit tagged U32 values: TermCtr.args_start up to3221230147, TypedOccurrence.term up to2147488749, CheckedBinding.ty up to2147488718.
716458 of732353 snapshot HeapNumber nodes currently have nonnegative signed32-range values;15118 have U32 high bit set. High flags are real but cannot alone explain every box.

Numeric exposure replaces unnamed hidden views with named property values and adds artificial smi-number nodes; these are not extra allocation evidence. Snapshot also exposes NaN in some descriptors; this may include default/slack/VM representations and is not a proved consumer-visible U32 correctness bug.
Low-bit re-encoding is now a falsifiable source-only experiment, not a proven memory fix. A clean paired compiler measurement remains mandatory.
decision: Proceed to one isolated source experiment: kind-specific low-bit owner/reverse tags preserving31-bit node and30-bit tape offsets, raw Arena pool APIs and raw name ids. Maintain decoded bounds, witness owner checks, source order and all publication/readback/lowering consumers. No generic U32 retagging, GC tuning, ABI driver change, smaller corpus or runtime patch.
